notes: 8 criteria covered. Suite: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider e1_tests -n0 -> 14 passed (serial and xdist). The test orders I created were released afterwards (expired or refunded); capacity is back to 2 of 3 open. The browser checkout check was re-authored once to read the session id from the Stripe URL instead of the navigated-away response (that was a problem in my test, not an app bug). The refund test uses a real Stripe PaymentIntent (real-pay), and Stripe delivered the refund webhooks.
